Gabby: Friendly to all, Gabby’s optimism is appreciated by most people and she is envied by women for her slight figure and her talkative nature. But more significant than that, Gabby is brave.
Gabriela:
Question: What does she do?
Answer: Anything she wants.
Not only because of her looks, but all doors will open for this girl because there are some people that, somehow, have been touched by magic. Up here in the commentary box we don’t understand it either.
Gabrielle: Gabrielle drives men berserk by getting regularly on her motorbike while wearing a mini-skirt and, because she’s pragmatic and eccentric, she doesn’t understand their reaction at all. She has short hair.
Gaenna: Like the male Einar, Gaenna rhymes with "When do you think you're gonna'?" but this girl isn't trained in martial arts, and so never learned how to kill a man with a single forefinger jab to the throat. However, Gaenna probes and looks and thinks and smiles and thinks some more, and then arrives at the solution with a unique kind of grace and energy. Does that make sense?
Gaewynne: Heavens to Mercy, you wouldn’t want to fight her, would you? If Gaewynne were a fishing vessel I suspect very few seas would scare her, and if she were a wolf you’d see her in one of those movies, caught staring out across a blizzard-covered tundra, snow and ice gathering on her whiskers, while she coldly surveys her prey some distance away. And she wouldn’t look cold. Life in the western world as a living, warm-hearted woman, therefore, presents her with a dream ride. As she knows, most people have no idea what true hardship really is. Personal motto: Be grateful for what you've got and work hard if you have to. Amen to that, My Lady.
Gai: Gai is not all that feminine and she is quite bare-knuckled about it all, but if you want to get something done in a hurry, and done properly, then you could do a lot worse than getting her on board.
Gail: Her name is as about as much fun as hacking off frost bitten toes with a knife and so Gail is naturally pretty tough, yet she’s a funny and relaxed character who is good company. And she makes an excellent CEO. Not bad, eh?
Gappy: If Gappy were a cop she'd not only be unbribable, but everyone in the village would know her on a first name basis. Despite never  attracting genuine violence and bloodshed, in front of the mirror every week she would still practice pulling her weapon from its holster quickly,  just in case, before pointing the gun at herself and shouting, “FREEEEEEEEZE!", god love her.
Gaye:
Gaye rarely tosses and turns in her sleep. Is there a decision to be made? What are the pros and cons, who will be impacted by such a decision and what is my role in this?
These are thought processes Gaye moves through very quickly. She’s not being dispassionate, she’s being real and she’s being fair. 
“Fuck Facebook opinion. Show me the facts and we’ll move from there.”
They may very well inscribe this on Gaye’s gravestone.
Gayl: "Shut up," she says, sternly. "Pain is good for you."
Gayle: Dear Gayle, I know the spelling is very different but I’m afraid you and Gail are twin sisters with identical DNA. Please, therefore, make your way to Gail. She is you and you is she, aside from one small issue. If the two of you are parachuting for example, you will generally land smoothly with two feet, where as 'Gail' will often end up either in a tree or a dam, or maybe caught in a fence.
Gaylie: Heaven bless this girl, for there are few people who bring as much enthusiasm to the table as she does, while at the same time beginning so many projects that end unexpectedly, catastrophically, comically and spectacularly. However, she knows very well that if you make no mistakes you learn no lessons. She could write a book on how to attack life. In fact, perhaps she already has?
Gaylin: Gaylin toils hard in the short term, but it generally means she'll prosper in the greater picture. She has a tough shell and like an army tank she can absorb quite a lot of damage and rarely, if ever, will she capitulate.
Gayner:
Gayner discusses issues not people and she’s usually the most knowledgeable person in the room. You might argue that she doesn’t giggle enough but, don’t worry, she’s happy. 
One question: Is she so busy that her sex/love life gets forgotten about? 
When she gets home from this conference we’ll ask her…
Gaynor:
Gaynor is the the Queen, President, boss, leader or manager who is loved by her underlings, and who also laugh at how funny she is when she gets angry. They know she's doing her best and they know, too, that she hasn't got a unpleasant bone in her body. It's just how it is.
Note: As a side job, she hosts people like Lawrence, once in a while, who pay her a lot of money for deeds so bizarre and fantastic we literally can't discuss them here.
Gemma: Usually physically gorgeous, Gemma is deceptively ambitious and will use her sexy smile to help her anyway she sees fit. Life is a game for her and she therefore devotes as much time as possible to having as much fun as possible. She is a loud drunk.
Gena: Gena is the kind of girl who, after a couple of champagnes, is likely to say yes to just about anything, so long as not too many people get hurt. The last time she was in New York, for instance, it was winter time and yep, she wanted to skate a lap of that big outdoor ice rink starkers. You might have seen her on Youtube. If you did, you're not likely to forget her.
Genelle: The note-taker, the PR, the diminutive office organiser, the stalwart. We'd be screwed without her.
Geneva: Geneva is one of these people who has literally no idea how a car functions. "Oil? What the hell is that?" she's asked more than once. Having said that, she tends to read human behaviour very well, which has probably saved more accidents and bloodshed than her driving skills ever would. She keeps her intelligence to herself for some reason. Why is that? Management thinks this is only a short-term thing, and that one day she might even run the company, and not just because all the head-honchos love her looks.
Genevieve: Slender, elegant and with a glorious sense of self, this girl operates from another realm. Your head sways with the euphoric grace of a Puccini aria as you say her name .…..Genevieve. Few may understand her properly and so what.
Genia: She’s not a Jeanie, she’s not a Fairy and she’s no Genius. What Genia is, however, is enthusiastic and caring.
Genine: Hmmm....let me see. Petite, demure, timid and well-behaved: bullshit. Have you ever been to the rodeo and seen those bulls stomp on the cowboys stupid enough to let go? Need I say anymore, although I will state the obvious: this girl doesn't die wondering. In the bedroom, in society and confronted with any questionable behaviours or individuals, Genine is an unfettered Beast of a Woman. Those poor male sods in the Middle East who don't understand women at all could learn a lot. GO  YOU GOOD THING!
Georga: Man, is she sick of spelling her name to people? But at least it hasn’t turned her into a psychopath. Georga takes it on the chin and if anything it has aided her to stand up for what she believes in. Don’t be fooled though, she’s no push-over. She has style and ambition, and she’s here to find her own path. Note, if you yourself are slightly lost, she’s good for sound advice. True story.
George: George does everything quite easily, and the only hiccup is that the maleness of her name blinds men to her true and natural beauty, which is both unique and substantial. So, look again gentlemen. (She’d make a great professional surfer.)
Georgette: Here’s a heads-up: if you want to deal with Georgette successfully and she’s not into any of her nicknames, never call her Goerge, Goergie or G. Only call her Georgette otherwise she’ll take her business, love, ambitions and money elsewhere. You got that?
Georgi: With the capacity to pulverise and inspire, Georgi is no push-over. No, she's not arrogant folks, just self-confident and serene. If you could bottle it you'd make a fortune. Having said all that, in her younger years at least, you'll see her at the 'in parties', where she seems to know everyone but, here's something, how many of that 'in crowd' donated money to the latest disaster cause? Georgi did.
Georgia: A country in her own right and a person in her own skin. Ambitious and confident, just say yes when you think you should and she won’t kill you.
Georgie: On one level, Georgie is a fuzzy little lamb who is so neat, cute and wonderful that she makes you want to throw up but, thankfully, no one is that nice and she taps into this empathy to go a long way.
Georgina: Aren’t female chimps terrific creatures? When Georgina is in heat, her hind-quarters become red and swollen but you’d be a fool to assume that she wasn’t outstanding value and highly intelligent. Absolutely.
Geraldine: The beautiful old girl became extinct about 65 million years ago when a meteor struck the earth somewhere near where Mexico is today. Prior to her extinction she was a giant herbivore that left piles of dung that were larger than a small car. What a wonderfully happy soul she was.
Gerlinda: Gerlinda has never misappropriated funds, and as the Head of Finance she'd be very disappointed in anyone who did.
Germaine: In a past life her name was Len.
Gertie:
“What? Gertie is here? Are you for real?”……
This tends to be the response of most people when Gertie arrives because she is surrounded by the kind of chaos which makes one piss oneself with laughter. And as a delicious breath of fresh air, we’re not surprised.
Gertrude: Clumsy, lovely and friendly, Gertrude is one of those people who, for whatever set of reasons, which are apparently dictated by the universe at large, attracts bizarre and almost unbelievable ‘coincidences’. As a school teacher she is tantamount to a life saver, as she is everywhere.
Giaan: A cocky male rooster trapped in a female body.
Gianna: Gianna is one of those unusual creatures who insists that, in a past life, she was a regal empress. From where in the world, we know not. The upshot of previously being at the top of the food chain means that, here today, she bosses people like no tomorrow, expecting them to do her bidding. It's actually not her fault. But, she has mellowed this time around and as time goes on, more and more do we see her laughing and joking around with her friends and peers, getting out that big, luscious smile of hers.
Gib: “Just give it here..!” she whines at her stage manager. She takes the ream of paper in her hands and studies it intensely. She frowns for a few seconds, flips over a page, then another, and then shoves it back in his face. “Nup. Piece of piss,” she says. “Relax. Now fuck off while I get changed.”   Gib.
Gigi: Yes, it's true. She was arrested by the Roman carabinieri for swimming nude in the Trevi Fountain at about 7 o'clock at night, mid-summer. You should have seen the reaction from the crowd…
Gilda: Say her name once and it stops and starts and falters, say it three times and you see the truth because it was there the whole time; that is, she might not be gilded in the classical sense but she’s certainly one of the great German secrets. Gilda is unusual and utterly lovely.
Gill: Her name is impossible to say if you’re anywhere near sleep because she carries a big, sexy, brash personality. She loves mingling with different people, the more the merrier, and she loves a good game of hide-and-seek.
Gillian: The tall and intelligent psychology student who wears vivid red lipstick and the brightest dresses anyone has ever seen. (They’re often covered with big embroided flowers.) Anyway, she’s raucous fun and a nightmare to argue with.
Gilly: Gilly is not a standard issue. You'll need training, you'll need a supervisor early-on and we suggest you practice in a safe area if you're going to involve yourself with The Gilly. Have people died? Yes, but it's a very rare thing. We've found that most users benefit in ways that none of us predicted. But, as we say, you need to put in the hours...
Gina:
Option A:  Sexy without being sensual. Passionate without being focussed. Unstable without being dangerous.

Option B:  The name of Kirsty’s vagina.
Ginger: A sexy box of fizz and fun and light! Does she tell the truth?...Usually, yes.
Gintra:
The name of an upcoming model of Toyota motor car - the Toyota Gintra. It's a new thing the company is trying, endeavouring to capture the quite specific market of upwardly mobile women who like their air con and lots of internal mirrors, with blue tooth and all that nav crap, but who also love a bit of four wheel driving. The TV ad for the car will feature four super models in a red Gintra, driving it up a rocky cliff before dropping into the ocean, fish swimming all around them as they drive along the bottom back to the beach. Then they get out of the car in their bikinis, and yes, a fish ends up stranded on the bonnet. Underneath the car at the end it will read:
Toyota Gintra – Sexy and Tough, with an emphasis on Tough.
Giorgia: Ever seen the movie High Fidelity? It’s a flick about a man who owns a record shop. Anyway, there is a character played by the startlingly beautiful Catherine Zeta-Jones. In terms of describing Giorgia you need look no further. And what a story she is…
Giovanna:
“Giovanna, Giovanna......where art thou Giovanna??” 
Men across the planet have been wailing that phrase outside her window for years. To no avail, usually, and she’s used to the attention these days. But, when you generate as much wonderful electromagnetic funk as she does you’re bound to emit a few ripples that alter the nature of things. Giovanna.
Gisela: Gisela, honey, yes, you’re very cute and seductive and all that, but Princesses don’t actually exist here in the real world. At some point, therefore, you will need to don some comfortable clothes and put in the hard yards. We’re really sorry to have to tell you that, because up here in the commentary box, we want princesses to exist too. A good way to get things moving? Tomorrow morning, go and do the thing that scares you the most, or at least put the wheels in motion. You won’t regret it.
Giuseppina: Formalities? She detests them. “Just get on with it,” she'll often heckle from the crowd at some function or other if the speeches are going on too long. She's quite the realist you know, and she's always eager to get all the chores and rubbish behind her so she can have a bit of fun.
Giverny: One of those girls who, at 16, owned every expensive perfume bottle known to women. Is she past all that rubbish yet? (Note: if she is French or European it’s a different story altogether, and one which involves either the ocean or horses, in very much a hands-on capacity. This Giverny has barely even heard of perfume.)
Giz: Giz fights for the cause and she quite happily forgoes any kind of self-promotion, and so she doesn’t really look normal, either, thank Christ. Imagine Giz in a Muslim country? She might very well pave the way for peace among idiotic men. Imagine that? Peace in the Middle East. Can we put her on a plane?…
Gizelle: Shazaam!! And yes, she’s got one hell of an ego.....
Gladys: Forget the boring social morays. Regardless of her socioeconomic status, if Gladys is at a party and, out of the blue, someone asks her to open her mouth and stick her tongue out in order to have her picture taken, she will immediately agree with unadulterated enthusiasm. The world needs more of them.
Glenda: Glenda is a peach that is devoid of any momentum. She was perfectly ripe about four weeks back but she fell from the tree a week ago and is now lying on the ground, beneath it, as a rather juicy lump. Which is to say, you do the best you can, you make the most fun possible with what you've got, when you've got it, and you retain your sense of humour at all times. And if you fancy getting nude and sexy in a field just for the hell of it, then bloody-well get to it. Amen for Glenda!
Glenis: A fair dinkum, u-beaut’, 100% genuine Australian Gum Tree.
Glenwyn: Ever seen a road map for inner London? Welcome to the levels of complexity in the beautiful Glenwyn. I'll come back in a month and see how you're getting on…..
Glenys: See Glenis, I’m delighted to say.
Gloria: A simple and happy soul who is careful with most things. She has a permed hairdo.
Glory: Jesus, lucky they didn’t name you ‘Total Fuck Up’ eh? Anyway Glory is a friendly, agreeable lass who has had no other choice. She follows the rules and shuns public attention.
Goddess: Goddess carries a whip, wears a studded leather collar around her neck, 4-inch stilletos that have mechanically sharpened heels on her feet and a smile fit for only those who enjoy the pain. Good luck!
Goldie:
“Screw that! The party will over by the time we get there!” she says, after having been told by the police that her and her girlfriends will need to drive all the way back into town and out and around the other way to avoid the flooded river. “Listen here sonny Jim, I’ve crossed this river a hundred times when it was higher than this, all before you were born.”
Ignoring the cops, Goldie plants her foot and before the officers can react her car is hurtling into the waters...
Gosia:
No, she ain't no goshawk, although she is reasonably fit and agile, and she has a large, open smile which makes a splendid welcome mat for those people who hear her name and say, "How do you say your name again?"
She's used to it, but it deosn't bother her anyway because Gosia possesses a loving, happy and relaxed nature, deep down, who likes meeting and talking to people any old time, and whether anyone says her name or not.
Grace: Born as a 40 year old and therefore measured and wise before her time, Grace has great faith in her friends because she often sees their future before they do. How do you top that?
Gracie: The name of a plush white rug next to a sun-filled window that you go and lie on for a lazy nap on a winter’s afternoon.
Grady: Her name is so smooth and unusually cool that people have difficulty remembering it and, consequently, her life is far more complex than it need be. But, beneath these frustrating moments, she is a sensual and worldly individual.
Greer: Intense, very bright and long-legged, Greer takes most things seriously and someone needs to give her a giraffe onesie.
Greta: Greta works for NASA. Does she do her hair? Rarely. Does she wear pretty clothes? Sometimes, but it's largely a fluke. Is she fucking wonderful? You betcha'.
Gretchen: As a geology PhD student, she loves all rocks (especially igneous ones), wears boots, hiking trousers and a flannel shirt that Jake would be proud of. There is also at least one crater on Mars named after her.
Gretel: A witch, and you’ve got to love a good witch. (Note that 19% of Gretels are horrendous and only cast evil spells, in which case they need to be taken out dancing whether they want to or not.)
Gretta: Now listen here, Miss Gretta - I don’t want to hear a single bloody pip out of you, okay?  I'm sick of your whinging about shit that doesn't matter. So, breathe, breathe again, and now  go and check out 'Greta'. Have a nice day! xx
Guinevere: Like the Yeti, Santa Claus, the Tooth Fairy and Drop Bears, we want her to exist but she just doesn’t. Does she?
Guineveve: The name given to an exotic and fiendishly confusing maze in the plush grounds of a 16th century French or Italian mansion. Courtesans of the day attempted to fornicate in them during afternoon tea parties.
Gwen:
Serious. She wears her name like a Chameleon wears its colours but Gwen is cool and electric on her day, such that you might have to look and think twice about how remarkably beautiful and/or enigmatic she is. 
(Note: Please read this name theory again, this time beginning at the end of the first sentence.)
Gwenda:
Gwenda is unequivocal in her approach to anything. Her moods arrive from the 40 corners of her globe, and they will range from unbridled flights of fancy; grim, determined moments inside the heat of a hard-fought battle and to the delights of sexual fantasy where the only limits are those bound inside her substantial imagination. 
In short, what is on offer here is a remarkable venture for friends, lovers and others. Gwenda: God love her, she ain’t normal.
Gwendolen: In a past life her name was Eric.
Gwendoline: Oh to be a princess again, she thinks to herself often. She did a past life regression once and, true enough, that's what she saw. Laid down with the chores of tending a large family in this life, she seriously wishes she could afford some maids to lend a hand.
Gweneth: The Controller. If you do the wrong thing she will withdraw her love. If you do the right thing she will return it.
Gwyneth: Gwyneth knows exactly what she wants and how to achieve it. Having said that, she’s open and humorous and affectionate and she enjoys her time off. She’s not the full stress-head you were led to believe.
Gwynneth: Gwynneth tends to act or speak from a solid footing. She knows what is what, this girl, and she moves with flare and with style. She's no where near as austere as we were led to believe.
Gypsy:
Gypsy swirls though life with such chaotic magnificence that nothing ever gets done. Who knows what she does with her life, but she’s certainly happy. 
WARNING: Don’t give her any whisky unless it’s an emergency.
